Be explicit about any duplicate IDs or parsing issues.

 print(c, sorted(x.unique())[:10], 'neg',sum(x<0), 'large neg',d.loc[x<-60,['date','sched_dep','actual_dep']].to_dict('records'))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
carriers=['AA','AS','B6','DL','UA','WN']; results={}; dupinfo={}
for c in carriers:
 d=pd.read_csv('airlines/'+c+'.csv')
 dup=d[d.flight_id.duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('flight_id')
 dupinfo[c]=(len(dup),dup.flight_id.nunique())
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy()
 if c=='AS':
  ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
  def conv(r,col):
   # UTC date/time, localize UTC then convert origin TZ
   return pd.Timestamp(r.date_utc+' '+r[col],tz='UTC').tz_convert(ZoneInfo(ap.loc[r.origin,'timezone']))
  sched=d.apply(lambda r:conv(r,'sched_dep_utc'),axis=1)
  actual=d.apply(lambda r: (pd.Timestamp(r.date_utc+' '+r.actual_dep_utc,tz='UTC') if pd.notna(r.actual_dep_utc) and str(r.actual_dep_utc).strip() else pd.NaT),axis=1)
  mask=sched.dt.month.isin([1,2]) & (sched.dt.year==2025)
  delay=(actual-sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
 else:
  sched=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep)
  actual=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep,errors='coerce')
  delay=(actual-sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
  delay=delay.where(delay>=-60,delay+1440)
  mask=sched.dt.month.isin([1,2]) & (sched.dt.year==2025)
 sub=d[mask].copy(); dd=delay[mask]; completed=(~sub.cancelled.astype(bool)) & dd.notna()
 results[c]=(int((completed & (dd>15)).sum()),int(completed.sum()),len(sub),int(sub.cancelled.sum()))
print(results,dupinfo)
print('totals',sum(x[0] for x in results.values()),sum(x[1] for x in results.values()))
